# Private combined layout-memo hook — bounded proof, no promotion

This sibling preserves the released fixed842 and COUNT-packed components.
It privately links actual C21/R34/R19/C29 against coherent53 fixture
`build/cache-editor-product/20261026T021924007962Z/fixture`. Canonical source,
Make/startup, resident bytes and the shared catalogue remain unchanged.

```
python3 tests/test_cache_layout_hook.py --fixture build/cache-editor-product/20261026T021924007962Z/fixture --run
```

The fixture imports the actual sealed private modules once through the checked
loader. The normal53 asset registration remains the base; an explicit checked
R34 import is the only extra component admission. No per-output supervisor,
host TOP/FE/row/key seed or parser replacement is used during the public gate.

## Fit and flow

| Private image | Bytes |
|---|---:|
| C21 page + new-allocation revoke |4077|
| R34 compact memo + coarse controller + initializer |3914|
| R19 outgoing publisher, explicit defined-bit mask |4094|
| C29 controller/template |2304|

The original89-byte common C21 initializer moves unchanged into R34op21.
C21 retains its owner claim, baseline admission and fold normalization.
Operations22/23 implement coarse PAGE_BEGIN/PAGE_STEP, with C21PS15 retaining
the coordinator. R34 tries a previously retained target first; on a miss it
captures the current published page before C21OPEN overwrites it. Every call
does one existing bounded memo unit. It calls no other overlay. A successful
restore is checked again by C21 and enters the real `cached_begin` caret/VIEW
republication and C22/R21 painting. Nowrap remains on the real fallback.

R34 uses the released COUNT-live codec and all its key/CRC/provider checks.
The private files copy that immutable codec; no released file was modified.
The one-page memo is not a two-entry replacement cache: restoring A destroys
primaryB. Repeated A↔B can recapture an already retained A unnecessarily.

## Explicit session policy

Private bit64 of `se_bc_flags` is a live-session permission, not a new public
ABI claim. Cold/H_INIT starts it clear. PAGE_BEGIN clears it **before** bounded
work; only a fully completed capture or restore rearms it. Abandoned work,
STOP or a missing continuation therefore cannot leave a permission armed.
The private C21cache clears it after a real newFEallocation. The actual fresh
C29resume template clears it before source invalidation. These paths do not
assume that numeric cold tokens or epochs are globally unique.

R19 is explicitly cloned: its defined-mask admits bit64 in addition to the
already-optional TRIED bit. Exactly one payload immediate changes EF→AF;
all other bytes are identical to the frozen original. The actual compiled
pre-CRC flag gate was executed for all256flag values with queue0/1 in both
variants. Original accepts33/49; private accepts33/49/97/113. Every undefined
bit and nonzero queue still refuses. This is a flag-policy proof, not a
relabeled complete R19 fault corpus.

## Actual public proof and measured cost

The diverse422 document is rendered as A, then actual public E_BOTTOM35
produces B at canonicalTOP422, then actual E_TOP34 returns to A. The last
render executes zero C20/C24/C25/C26 entries. Live decoded packets, all64,000
pixels/1,000attributes, source/history/clipboard/shim and the full16MiB outside
exact primary/memo/body-cache spans match. Selection/caret rebinding uses the
real consumer. The same public sequence runs on unmodified coherent53 with
the same extra checked import as a comparator.

| Render interval | Private hook | Original53 |
|---|---:|---:|
| Initial A, including baseline admission |4,849,353|4,847,676|
| B, including memo capture |946,552|386,082|
| Return A |2,006,908|2,606,518|
| B + return A |2,953,460|2,992,600|
| All three |7,802,813|7,840,276|

The complete measured render sequence saves only **0.48%** (B+return1.31%).
This is not worth promotion. Public command/navigation costs are outside the
named render intervals; no emulated-cycle, physical latency or native claim
is made. The first isolated packed-hit result cannot substitute for this
amortized measurement.

A real FEfree/reallocation forces fresh C20 work and leaves permission0.
The actual new resume prefix executes through managed-unverify and stops at
doc_invalidate: flags81→17 proves bit64 revocation while source stays exact.
This is not a complete suspend/snapshot/resume proof.

## Remaining gates and next policy question

No canonical registration, native run, stack graph, full lifecycle snapshot,
selection matrix, owner/cancel/missing-leaf matrix or edit-rebase claim is
made for this combined profile. Component-only reconstruction/refusal proofs
remain separately archived with their original scopes. The root dispatcher
and existing loader integrity policy are not changed.

Before any further implementation, measure a policy that avoids recapturing
the same already-authenticated current page. It must bind the complete live
header/caret/policy/source/settings/font/fold/provider identity, not TOP alone,
and corrupt payloads must still fail the full restore CRC. Opt-in or repeated-
visit admission is another policy question. Neither is implemented here.
